relations: As the press head descends onto the top brick, that brick compresses and begins to fracture.
Progressive loading shatters the stacked bricks into fragments that detach and fall outward.
Ejected debris accumulates around the striped base as the stack height reduces under the platen.
The lower intact bricks remain supported on the base until the descending platen reaches them.
